cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Your Turn
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Your name's beside bathroom duty. Here's the mop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then this is your training opportunity.
